Its declared path shim rewrites ANY /home/claude/edl/ prefix, not only the intended one; today the frozen module opens exactly one such path and every value taken from it is asserted.

THE_TWO_DRIVERS_ARE_NOT_LOAD_BEARING_BEC: each calls the frozen module for every scientific value and adds none of its own. tlmr01_device_measure serialises measure_world's return verbatim; tlmr01_run_analysis calls aggregate, eligibility and the frozen cascade unchanged. Neither is imported by the frozen run or analysis closures, and the device path they use is cross-checked field for field against a container re-measurement.
CONCLUSION: no post-C2 file influences any scientific quantity or the disposition. The frozen C2 analysis remains the sole source of scientific quantities and selection.
